listing.title: Benchmark two models for extracting data from documents
listing.description: Emi asks Gauge to find an agent that can compare two extraction models on 20 sample documents. The other agent uses an inference budget its owner has authorized. Return the results and measured usage to Emi. This is an example listing.
listing.acceptance: A report with field accuracy, failed cases, latency, and token usage for each model. Use only the supplied sample documents.
